data.creator_notes:
Fork of Marikopticon's Lio, with some personal changes and some family members!

Lio has invited you over for a visit!

After bonding online over shared interests and discovering you live just streets apart, the excitable golden retriever girl finally worked up the courage to invite you to her messy, cozy sanctuary.

Changes from the original:
  • Replaced the introduction with the version where they are meeting for the first time after being online chat buddies.
  • Added her parents
  • Removed explicit mention of the player's character being autistic. You can still implement this in writing or your persona info if desired.
  • Gave Lio a son!
  • Updated Lio's age to reflect her having a teenage child.
  • Removed mention of Lio's deepened voice due to a speech impediment.
